dependence_interpretation: These are distinct vulnerability IDs/defects under the (CVE,function) estimand, but not independent call-depth locations; neither CVE is deduplicated.
depth_definition: Shortest number of direct or resolved-indirect static semantic may-call edges from the configured executable entry point; main is depth zero when main is that entry.

disposition_taxonomy.depth_applicable: At least one uniquely mapped, verified vulnerable runtime function has a numeric semantic depth; any additional nonnumeric functions remain individually accounted for.
disposition_taxonomy.historical_build_unavailable: Documented faithful build/IR or executable-scope reconstruction could not be completed; diagnostics retained.
disposition_taxonomy.historical_source_unavailable: Documented acquisition/reconstruction attempts could not establish the exact vulnerable source.
disposition_taxonomy.not_applicable_build_or_configuration_on: Primary evidence establishes build, packaging, or configuration vulnerability without an applicable runtime C-function depth.
disposition_taxonomy.not_applicable_no_vulnerable_runtime_fun: Primary evidence establishes a vulnerability unit that is not a runtime C function.
disposition_taxonomy.semantic_analysis_unavailable: Build/IR exists but the frozen semantic analysis failed or is unavailable; diagnostics retained.
disposition_taxonomy.semantic_unreachable: Unique vulnerable identity is unreachable in the semantic may-call graph; depth remains null.
disposition_taxonomy.source_identity_ambiguous: Multiple semantic identities match; all candidates retained without selection.
disposition_taxonomy.source_identity_not_found: Verified vulnerable source identity is absent from the semantic graph.
disposition_taxonomy.unresolved_indirect_dispatch: Unresolved semantic indirect flow prevents a numeric vulnerable-function path; no synthetic edge.
disposition_taxonomy.vulnerable_function_mapping_unresolved: Evidence review completed but no defensible exact vulnerable function mapping established; not a synonym for not applicable.

mapping_order: Freeze evidence-based specimen/function mapping and its per-decision fingerprint before new semantic measurement. Freeze the complete mapping-artifact fingerprint before aggregate statistics. Pilot reuse is explicitly labeled prior verified measurement.
multi_program_rule: The observation unit is (CVE, vulnerable function). Executable membership is disclosure-governed and frozen per CVE; shared functions preserve each affected executable context and use the approved arithmetic mean within (CVE,function).

multi_program_rule_resolution.approved_by: explicit user instruction conveying the study decision
multi_program_rule_resolution.sensitivity_independence_warning: Executable contexts sharing a CVE/function are dependent provenance contexts and are not independent vulnerability observations.

nonnumeric_rule: Never impute. Not applicable, unavailable, unresolved, ambiguous and unreachable remain distinct. An unfinished investigation is pending, not a justified unavailability result.
scope_rule: Linker-exact whenever faithfully recoverable; other scope kinds require explicit justification and separate reporting, never silent pooling.

statistics_conventions.cve_weighting: Arithmetic mean of per-CVE means among CVEs with >=1 legitimate numeric depth; distinguish from observation-level mean
statistics_conventions.missing_values: Excluded from numeric arithmetic only, never population accounting; all denominators stated
statistics_conventions.quartiles: Linear interpolation at p*(n-1), p=0.25 and 0.75; IQR=Q3-Q1

statistics_gate: Exactly 24 final evidence-justified dispositions; complete verified mapping freeze; every numeric observation derives from the frozen semantic backend and has explicit scope/path provenance.
